papers.title: Back to Pixels: Lifting Latent Video Diffusion into Pixel Space
papers.translated_title: 回到像素：将潜在视频扩散提升至像素空间
papers.author: Yanke Song
papers.summary: Frontier video generation models work in a VAE latent space that compresses video in both space and time. This compression made training tractable, but now limits high-resolution, controllable, and interactive generation -- doubling resolution quadruples token count, conditions apply to groups of frames rather than individual ones, and each response must wait for the rest of its multi-frame block. We present PixVid, a simple yet effective method that lifts a pretrained latent video model to directly generate every frame in pixel space. PixVid keeps the diffusion transformer and replaces the VAE decoder with a convolutional head that renders its outputs into pixels. We find that predicting clean video rather than velocity, together with a larger noise shift, is key to quality. Finetuned from Wan2.1-14B, PixVid is competitive with the latent baseline within $\sim 1.3$M training clips. Working framewise in pixels, it generates at $2\times$ higher resolution with the same per-frame token count, keeps depth-conditioned video editing aligned under fast motion, and responds to each action at the next frame. Project page: https://chenshuo20.github.io/PixVid/
papers.translated_summary: 前沿视频生成模型在VAE潜空间中进行工作，该空间在空间和时间两个维度上对视频进行压缩。这种压缩使训练变得可行，但如今限制了高分辨率、可控和交互式生成——分辨率翻倍会使token数量变为四倍，条件作用于帧组而非单帧，且每个响应都必须等待其多帧块中其余帧的完成。我们提出PixVid，一种简单而有效的方法，将预训练的潜空间视频模型提升为直接在像素空间中生成每一帧。PixVid保留扩散Transformer，并用一个卷积头替换VAE解码器，将输出渲染为像素。我们发现，预测干净视频而非速度，并结合更大的噪声偏移，是保证质量的关键。从Wan2.1-14B微调而来，PixVid在约1.3M训练片段内与潜空间基线具有竞争力。在像素空间中逐帧工作，它以相同的每帧token数量生成2倍更高分辨率的视频，在快速运动下保持深度条件视频编辑的对齐，并在下一帧对每个动作做出响应。项目页面：https://chenshuo20.github.io/PixVid/

papers.title: Unbundling Multimodal Vision Encoding
papers.translated_title: 解耦多模态视觉编码
papers.author: Ellis Brown
papers.summary: How multimodal language models should encode visual input remains up for debate. Most models use a pretrained vision encoder, while some recent recipes train the encoder from scratch with the language model or remove it entirely. Vision encoders bundle together three design choices: a visual prior from upstream pretraining, dedicated vision capacity, and pre-fusion placement of that capacity (i.e., before the multimodal backbone). Because published models also differ in data, architecture, and compute, comparing them cannot isolate the effect of each choice. We disentangle these choices via a controlled framework where we pretrain all models from scratch on common data and compare them on visual question answering and language benchmarks at matched lifetime compute. We find that the visual prior is not necessary; an encoder trained jointly from scratch is on par with a pretrained one, without a separate training stage. What matters instead is dedicated vision capacity: an encoder-free model trails on visual understanding even when its backbone is enlarged by the encoder's parameter count. Yet that capacity need not precede multimodal fusion, as vision-only modules added in-fusion to early backbone layers perform comparably to a pre-fusion encoder and can lower time to first token. These results also hold across backbone sizes, when encoder pretraining is treated as free, and when starting from a pretrained language model. Overall, our findings favor dedicated vision capacity trained jointly with the backbone and placed early within it.
papers.translated_summary: 多模态语言模型应如何编码视觉输入仍存争议。多数模型使用预训练的视觉编码器，而近期一些方案则从头与语言模型联合训练编码器，或完全移除编码器。视觉编码器捆绑了三个设计选择：来自上游预训练的视觉先验、专用的视觉容量，以及该容量在多模态融合之前的位置（即在多模态主干之前）。由于已发表的模型在数据、架构和计算上各不相同，直接比较无法分离每个选择的影响。我们通过一个受控框架来厘清这些选择：在共同数据上从头预训练所有模型，并在匹配的生命周期计算量下，在视觉问答和语言基准上进行比较。我们发现视觉先验并非必要；从头联合训练的编码器与预训练编码器表现相当，且无需单独的预训练阶段。真正重要的是专用的视觉容量：无编码器模型在视觉理解上落后，即使其主干按编码器的参数量进行了扩大。然而，该容量不必先于多模态融合，因为在融合中添加到早期主干层的纯视觉模块与预融合编码器表现相当，并能降低首 token 时间。这些结果在不同主干规模下、将编码器预训练视为免费时，以及从预训练语言模型出发时均成立。总体而言，我们的发现支持专用视觉容量与主干联合训练并置于主干早期。

papers.title: TTB: Test-time Baking for Efficient Rendering of Decoder-only View Synthesis Models
papers.translated_title: TTB：用于仅解码器视图合成模型高效渲染的测试时烘焙
papers.author: Chin-Yang Lin
papers.summary: Decoder-only Large View Synthesis Models (LVSMs) with KV-cache have recently achieved state-of-the-art quality by regressing novel views from neural networks without reconstructing 3D geometry, while Test-Time Training (TTT) layers save computation but sacrifice quality. We propose Test-Time Baking (TTB), a strategy that learns to bake global scene information from cross-view attention into a lightweight MLP, enabling fast and high-fidelity novel-view decoding. The first key is to repurpose the fast-weight MLP of TTT to learn the cross-view attention mapping explicitly from its input-output pairs, rather than replacing attention entirely, achieving the same rendering efficiency as TTT while delivering substantially higher quality. The second key addresses a modality misalignment between context prefilling and novel-view rendering: we disentangle context tokens into camera-only context rendering tokens to serve as TTB input, and context ground-truth tokens with image content to serve as the TTB mapping target, ensuring the baked MLPs are relieved of the modality generalization challenge between context and novel-view processing. Our method achieves up to **23x** rendering speedup with quality on par with the state-of-the-art across several benchmarks. Project page: https://test-time-baking.github.io
papers.translated_summary: 仅解码器的大视图合成模型（LVSMs）结合KV-cache近期通过从神经网络回归新视图而不重建3D几何，达到了最先进的质量，而测试时训练（TTT）层节省了计算但牺牲了质量。我们提出测试时烘焙（TTB），一种学习将跨视图注意力中的全局场景信息烘焙到轻量级MLP中的策略，从而实现快速且高保真的新视图解码。第一个关键是将TTT的快速权重MLP重新利用，从其输入-输出对中显式学习跨视图注意力映射，而非完全替换注意力，从而在达到与TTT相同渲染效率的同时提供显著更高的质量。第二个关键解决了上下文预填充与新视图渲染之间的模态错位：我们将上下文token解耦为仅相机上下文渲染token作为TTB输入，以及带有图像内容的上下文真值token作为TTB映射目标，确保烘焙的MLP免受上下文与新视图处理之间模态泛化挑战的影响。我们的方法在多个基准上实现了高达**23倍**的渲染加速，质量与最先进水平相当。项目页面：https://test-time-baking.github.io

papers.title: ArchSpace: Recording, Reviewing, and Referencing LLM Architecture Research
papers.translated_title: ArchSpace：记录、审阅与引用LLM架构研究
papers.author: Jie Wang
papers.summary: Model architecture shapes the scaling behavior, training efficiency, and inference cost of LLMs, making it a central focus of both industry and academia. In industry, teams such as those behind DeepSeek, Qwen, and Kimi routinely introduce architectural innovations, yet public reports rarely document which ideas succeeded, which were abandoned, and why. In academia, limited compute and inconsistent baselines often restrict evaluations to small-scale, single-point comparisons, making it difficult to establish whether improvements hold at larger scales or translate into broader impact. ArchSpace addresses both gaps as a public platform for Recording, Reviewing, and Referencing Architecture Researc}: each proposal is recorded with its experiments and reasoning, reviewed by the community, and referenced by later work. To evaluate ideas before costly large-scale training, ArchSpace leverages scaling laws to predict model loss at larger scales from smaller experiments, a practice widely adopted in industry. We provide initial references that make the platform usable: Qwen3.5 and OLMo3 baselines, fitted scaling laws, and a reusable training recipe. Ideas validated through this review can in turn become new baselines, and ArchSpace thereby aims to broaden the range of ideas that shape the next generation of models.
papers.translated_summary: 模型架构决定了大型语言模型的扩展行为、训练效率与推理成本，因而成为产业界与学术界共同关注的核心。在产业界，DeepSeek、Qwen 和 Kimi 背后的团队等会常规性地引入架构创新，但公开报告很少记录哪些想法成功了、哪些被放弃以及原因何在。在学术界，有限算力与不一致的基线往往使评估局限于小规模、单点比较，难以确定改进在更大规模上是否依然成立，或能否转化为更广泛的影响。ArchSpace 作为面向架构研究的记录、评审与引用的公共平台，同时弥补了这两方面缺口：每个提案都连同其实验与推理被记录下来，由社区评审，并被后续工作引用。为在昂贵的大规模训练之前评估想法，ArchSpace 利用缩放定律从较小实验预测更大规模下的模型损失，这一做法在产业界被广泛采用。我们提供初始参考以使平台可用：Qwen3.5 与 OLMo3 基线、拟合的缩放定律，以及可复用的训练配方。经此评审验证的想法反过来可成为新的基线，ArchSpace 由此旨在拓宽塑造下一代模型的想法范围。

papers.title: ProtoVis-Nav: Prototypical Visual Imagination for Visual-Spatial Aligned UAV Navigation
papers.translated_title: ProtoVis-Nav：用于视觉-空间对齐无人机导航的原型视觉想象
papers.author: Guangyuan Sui
papers.summary: Vision language navigation (VLN) is very challenging for Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) since small errors in 3D motion prediction can lead to navigation errors and collisions. Unable to fathom execution outcomes in 3D environments, existing methods often struggle to predict accurate navigation waypoints from language instructions. To solve this, we introduce the Prototypical Visual Imagination framework, shortened as ProtoVis-Nav, which forces the model to imagine an outcome-associated local visual representation for the intended next UAV movement. Specifically, we predict feature prototypes and use their linear combination to estimate the visual feature of the target region. In this manner, the VLN model first imagines the local visual representation of the next intended location, and then uses predicted prototypes as context for generating the final action, promoting alignment between visual context and waypoint outputs. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of the ProtoVis-Nav framework and show substantial improvements over existing baselines.
papers.translated_summary: 视觉语言导航（VLN）对无人机（UAV）而言极具挑战性，因为三维运动预测中的微小误差可能导致导航错误和碰撞。现有方法无法在三维环境中理解执行结果，往往难以根据语言指令预测准确的导航航点。为解决这一问题，我们引入了原型视觉想象框架，简称为ProtoVis-Nav，该框架强制模型为预期的下一无人机运动想象一个与结果相关的局部视觉表征。具体而言，我们预测特征原型并利用其线性组合来估计目标区域的视觉特征。通过这种方式，VLN模型首先想象下一预期位置的局部视觉表征，然后将预测的原型作为上下文来生成最终动作，促进视觉上下文与航点输出之间的对齐。大量实验证明了ProtoVis-Nav框架的有效性，并显示出相较于现有基线的显著改进。

papers.title: Internalizing Investment Mandates: A Neurosymbolic RL Approach to Portfolio Allocation
papers.translated_title: 内化投资授权：一种神经符号强化学习的投资组合配置方法
papers.author: Zeynep Yıldız
papers.summary: Institutional portfolios operate under investment policy statements that specify asset allocation constraints, often conditioned on market regime information. Deep reinforcement learning has been shown to optimize financial performance but typically does not enforce rule compliance, making it unsuitable for real-world deployment. Existing neurosymbolic methods such as Probabilistic Logic Policy Gradient (PLPG) offer constraint-satisfying reinforcement learning (RL) via differentiable symbolic supervision but assume a finite, discrete action space. We present a PLPG-inspired continuous allocation method that estimates the probability that the policy's own executed action satisfies the investment mandate, using reparameterized Monte Carlo sampling, and adds it to the training objective. No post-hoc enforcement mechanism intercepts actions at inference time and compliance is learned by the agent. Audited directly on deterministic mean actions with no correction, the policy reduces violations of a six-rule regime-conditional mandate from 96-98% for unconstrained RL and 33.4% for a reward-penalty baseline to 4.8%, showing that a continuous-action neurosymbolic policy can substantially internalize a symbolic mandate.
papers.translated_summary: 机构投资组合依据投资政策声明运作，该声明规定了资产配置约束，且往往以市场状态信息为条件。深度强化学习已被证明能够优化财务表现，但通常无法强制执行规则合规性，因而难以适用于现实部署。现有的神经符号方法，如概率逻辑策略梯度（PLPG），通过可微符号监督提供满足约束的强化学习（RL），但假设动作空间为有限离散空间。我们提出一种受 PLPG 启发的连续配置方法，利用重参数化蒙特卡洛采样估计策略自身执行动作满足投资授权的概率，并将其加入训练目标。推理阶段没有事后强制执行机制拦截动作，合规性由智能体学习获得。直接对确定性平均动作进行审计且不做任何修正时，该策略将违反六规则状态条件授权的比例从无约束 RL 的 96-98% 和奖励惩罚基线的 33.4% 降至 4.8%，表明连续动作神经符号策略能够实质性地内化符号授权。

papers.title: K2V: Generative Keyframing For Physically Plausible Video Generation
papers.translated_title: K2V：用于生成物理上合理视频的生成式关键帧
papers.author: Felix O'Mahony
papers.summary: Video diffusion models are able to generate samples with high-quality appearance and textural qualities. However, content produced by these methods is known to exhibit significant physical errors. This is because, in a classical video generation setting, all physical reasoning must take place simultaneously and exclusively within the diffusion process.We propose to resolve these issues by redistributing the task of physical reasoning onto a language model-backed keyframe generation module, which allows for explicit reasoning in language, and fine-grained control over the appearance of the video at important moments in the video. We then condition a video generation model with these keyframes, reducing the role of the diffusion model to the simpler task of interpolating between physically-correct intermediate states, rather than inferring an entire sequence with diffusion. Results demonstrate that our approach significantly outperforms existing approaches, achieving state-of-the-art performance on the Physics-IQ Verified benchmark and PhyGenBench.
papers.translated_summary: 视频扩散模型能够生成具有高质量外观和纹理特性的样本。然而，这些方法生成的内容已知会表现出显著的物理错误。这是因为在经典的视频生成设置中，所有物理推理必须同时且仅在整个扩散过程内进行。我们提出通过将物理推理任务重新分配到由语言模型支持的关键帧生成模块来解决这些问题，该模块允许在语言中进行显式推理，并在视频的重要时刻对视频外观进行细粒度控制。然后，我们以这些关键帧为条件来引导视频生成模型，将扩散模型的作用降低为在物理正确的中间状态之间进行插值的更简单任务，而不是用扩散推断整个序列。结果表明，我们的方法显著优于现有方法，在Physics-IQ Verified基准和PhyGenBench上达到了最先进的性能。

papers.title: AgentSSL: Can MLE Agents Leverage Unlabeled Data?
papers.translated_title: AgentSSL：MLE智能体能否利用无标签数据？
papers.author: Ethan Lin
papers.summary: Applying machine learning systems to new domains introduces bottlenecks in both labeled data acquisition and manual pipeline engineering. While recent MLE agents show promise in automating pipeline design, they have been studied almost exclusively in fully supervised settings, leaving them untested in realistic regimes where labeled data is scarce but unlabeled data is abundant. In this work, we introduce Agentic Semi-Supervised Learning (AgentSSL), framing SSL as a program search problem and studying how agents navigate this space under limited supervision. We find that even under weak feedback and matched compute, agents can synthesize code that combines and adapts established SSL techniques, exceeding the strongest human-engineered baselines in 8 of 12 settings by up to +21.8%. However, our results identify program selection as a critical bottleneck in AgentSSL, where performance drops by as much as 47% when selecting based on the agent's feedback metric. To systematically study this bottleneck, we introduce ProgramSelectBench, a large-scale benchmark with a combined total of 16,977 agent-generated and human-engineered SSL programs, and evaluate both unsupervised and active program selection methods. We further evaluate AgentSSL on real-world ecology detection tasks, highlighting the opportunities and challenges of transferring agent-discovered strategies beyond controlled benchmarks.
papers.translated_summary: 将机器学习系统应用于新领域会在标注数据获取和人工流程工程两方面引入瓶颈。尽管近期的MLE智能体在自动化流程设计方面展现出前景，但它们几乎只在全监督设置下被研究，尚未在标注数据稀缺但无标注数据丰富的现实场景中接受检验。在本工作中，我们引入智能体半监督学习（AgentSSL），将SSL构建为程序搜索问题，并研究智能体在有限监督下如何导航这一空间。我们发现，即使在弱反馈和匹配计算量下，智能体也能合成结合并适配已有SSL技术的代码，在12个设置中的8个上超过最强的人工工程基线，最高提升+21.8%。然而，我们的结果识别出程序选择是AgentSSL中的关键瓶颈，当基于智能体的反馈指标进行选择时，性能下降幅度可达47%。为系统研究这一瓶颈，我们引入ProgramSelectBench，一个大规模基准，包含总计16,977个智能体生成和人工工程的SSL程序，并评估无监督和主动程序选择方法。我们进一步在真实世界生态检测任务上评估AgentSSL，突出将智能体发现的策略迁移到受控基准之外的机会与挑战。

papers.title: BrickFlow: Connectivity-Guided Brick Reconstruction
papers.translated_title: BrickFlow：连通性引导的积木重建
papers.author: Peter Kulits
papers.summary: Given a set of LEGO parts and an image of an assembled object, our task is to infer the pose of each part to assemble the object. In contrast with traditional 3D reconstruction, doing so requires satisfying discrete physical constraints, which provide structure but render the problem combinatorial and highly sensitive to small pose errors. To learn a prior over how parts fit together, we train a set-conditioned SE(3) flow model on procedurally generated assemblies. We then finetune this model to inject image conditioning, using 1% as much data. However, while the learned flow captures global structure, it does not enforce connectivity. To address this, we introduce an analytic connectivity-field guidance to pull predictions toward connected assemblies at test time. Through this, we demonstrate improved build quality with model size, pretraining, and guidance. We make our models and data available for research purposes at https://kulits.github.io/BrickFlow/
papers.translated_summary: 给定一组乐高零件和一个组装物体的图像，我们的任务是推断每个零件的位姿以组装该物体。与传统三维重建不同，这样做需要满足离散的物理约束，这些约束提供了结构，但使问题具有组合性且对微小的位姿误差高度敏感。为了学习零件如何组合在一起的先验，我们在程序生成的组装体上训练了一个以集合为条件的SE(3)流模型。然后我们对该模型进行微调以注入图像条件，使用的数据量仅为1%。然而，虽然学习到的流捕捉了全局结构，但它并不强制连通性。为了解决这个问题，我们引入了一种解析连通性场引导，在测试时将预测拉向连通的组装体。通过这种方式，我们展示了随着模型规模、预训练和引导的增强而提升的构建质量。我们将模型和数据用于研究目的，发布于 https://kulits.github.io/BrickFlow/

papers.title: Learning When Diffusion Language Models Should Regenerate
papers.translated_title: 学习扩散语言模型何时应当重新生成
papers.author: Minhae Oh
papers.summary: Remasking allows diffusion language models to revisit generated text, but effective correction requires knowing when and what to revise. Our diagnosis on Sudoku reveals two gaps. Hidden states contain error information that token confidence does not reliably expose, and remasking an isolated error usually reproduces it when the surrounding context remains fixed. These findings motivate DiVR , a verifier that predicts whether a partially generated sequence will reach a correct answer. Trained on the final correctness of the model's own trajectories, DiVR decides when to regenerate a block and which alternative to retain, while the generator itself stays unchanged. On five reasoning benchmarks with LLaDA-8B-Base, DiVR raises the average accuracy of the fine-tuned generator from 35.3\% to 43.4\% at $1.9$-$3.5\times$ the cost of greedy decoding, above search baselines that use $3.8$-$7.4\times$. It also complements post-training such as supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning, and generalizes to other generators, including Dream.
papers.translated_summary: 重掩码使扩散语言模型能够重新审视已生成的文本，但有效纠错需要知道何时修改以及修改什么。我们在数独任务上的诊断揭示了两处不足。隐藏状态中包含错误信息，而词元置信度无法可靠地将其暴露出来；并且，在周围上下文保持不变的情况下，对孤立错误进行重掩码通常会重现该错误。这些发现促成了 DiVR，一种预测部分生成的序列能否得到正确答案的验证器。DiVR 以模型自身轨迹的最终正确性为训练目标，决定何时重新生成一个块以及保留哪个备选方案，而生成器本身保持不变。在 LLaDA-8B-Base 上的五个推理基准测试中，DiVR 将微调后生成器的平均准确率从 35.3% 提升至 43.4%，成本为贪心解码的 1.9 至 3.5 倍，低于使用 3.8 至 7.4 倍成本的搜索基线。它还能与监督微调和强化学习等后训练方法互补，并可泛化到包括 Dream 在内的其他生成器。

papers.title: Distinct input-output relationships between basal forebrain subnuclei underlie heterogeneous cholinergic modulation of the mouse cortex
papers.translated_title: 基底前脑亚核之间不同的输入-输出关系构成了小鼠皮层胆碱能调制异质性的基础
papers.author: Tan, J.
papers.summary: The basal forebrain (BF) supports many behavioral functions via its brain-wide projections, which can be recruited independently and task specifically. However, the anatomical underpinnings for this functional heterogeneity are poorly understood. Here, we compared two mouse BF subnuclei, the horizontal diagonal band (HDB) and the substantial innominata (SI), in terms of their anatomical connectivity and functional recruitment. Using anterograde and retrograde tracing, we show that they target largely segregated forebrain regions, but their input comes from a partially overlapping subset of regions. However, many neurons within each region project to just one of the subnuclei, suggesting they can be recruited independently. To test this, we combined optogenetics and widefield Ca2+ imaging and showed that stimulating prefrontal cortical projections to the HDB or SI results in distinct large-scale patterns of cortical activity via a cholinergic mechanism. Our results provide an anatomical basis for the flexible, area-specific cholinergic modulation of brain function.
papers.translated_summary: 基底前脑（BF）通过其全脑投射支持许多行为功能，这些投射可以被独立且任务特异性地招募。然而，这种功能异质性的解剖学基础尚不清楚。在此，我们比较了两种小鼠BF亚核——水平斜角带（HDB）和无名质（SI）——在解剖连接和功能招募方面的差异。利用顺行和逆行示踪，我们显示它们主要靶向彼此分离的前脑区域，但其输入来自部分重叠的区域子集。然而，每个区域内的许多神经元仅投射到其中一个亚核，表明它们可以被独立招募。为了验证这一点，我们结合了光遗传学和宽场Ca2+成像，并显示刺激前额叶皮层到HDB或SI的投射通过胆碱能机制导致不同的大规模皮层活动模式。我们的结果为脑功能的灵活、区域特异性胆碱能调制提供了解剖学基础。

papers.title: Visual object recognition in the fly: the internal representation of a predator drives defensive behaviour
papers.translated_title: 苍蝇的视觉物体识别：捕食者的内部表征驱动防御行为
papers.author: Denagamage, S.
papers.summary: Animals recognize visual objects and respond to them appropriately to survive. This process is thought to unfold in stages: the visual scene is first deconstructed into constituent features, which are then reconstructed into representations of object identity and relayed to motor circuits. Here we define a neural circuit in Drosophila that underlies the visual recognition of a natural predator, the parasitoid wasp, and orchestrates defence. We found that flies exhibit a repertoire of directed defensive actions structured by the wasp's position within the fly's field of view. Expression of these behaviours is driven by visual detection of a conspicuous morphological cue -- the wasp's elongated antennae. A small subset of lobula columnar (LC) visual projection neuron types are required for defence and are activated by constituent visual features of the wasp. Three LC types respond selectively to the wasp's antennae, and relay this information to LC9, which sums antennal- and body-feature signals to form a composite representation of the wasp. Spatial filtering of this representation onto a descending premotor pathway translates the wasp's location in visual space into directed defence. Feature combination followed by spatial filtering may constitute a general mechanism for coupling object identity to context-appropriate action.
papers.translated_summary: 动物识别视觉对象并对其作出适当反应以求生存。这一过程被认为分阶段展开：视觉场景首先被解构为构成性特征，随后这些特征被重建为对象身份的表征，并传递至运动回路。在此，我们定义了果蝇中的一个神经回路，该回路构成对天敌——寄生蜂——的视觉识别基础，并协调防御行为。我们发现，果蝇表现出一系列定向防御动作，其结构由黄蜂在果蝇视野中的位置所决定。这些行为的表达由对显著形态线索——黄蜂细长的触角——的视觉检测所驱动。一小部分小叶柱状（LC）视觉投射神经元类型是防御所必需的，并被黄蜂的构成性视觉特征所激活。三种LC类型对黄蜂的触角选择性响应，并将此信息传递至LC9，后者汇总触角与身体特征信号，形成黄蜂的复合表征。将该表征空间滤波至下行前运动通路，可将黄蜂在视觉空间中的位置转化为定向防御。特征组合继而空间滤波，可能构成一种将对象身份与情境适宜动作相耦合的一般机制。

papers.title: Clofarabine enforces dual host-pathogen translational arrest and disarms enteric bacterial virulence
papers.translated_title: 氯法拉滨强制实施宿主-病原体双重翻译停滞并解除肠道细菌毒力
papers.author: Deans, N. D.
papers.summary: Enteropathogenic and enterohaemorrhagic Escherichia coli (EPEC/EHEC) cause severe global diarrhoeal disease, exacerbated by rising antimicrobial resistance. Pathogenesis relies on attaching and effacing lesions, where bacteria generate actin pedestals to adhere, replicate, and destroy intestinal microvilli. To identify novel anti-virulence candidates targeting this process, we conducted a high-throughput phenotypic screen quantifying pedestal formation via high-content fluorescence microscopy. We identified the anticancer nucleotide analogue clofarabine as a potent inhibitor of EPEC growth and pathogenesis. Distinct from its oncology mechanism - inducing DNA chain termination and apoptosis - clofarabine competes with bacterial ATP-dependent processes to impede gene transcription, protein synthesis, and Type III Secretion System (T3SS) function. Remarkably, EPEC counteracts this inhibition by cleaving clofarabine, enabling restored protein synthesis and resumed growth. Furthermore, we report for the first time that clofarabine suppresses protein translation in human monocytes, suggesting an uncharacterised translational impact on mammalian cells. These findings reveal host and bacterial translation as interconnected vulnerabilities to purine antimetabolites, offering a novel strategy to disarm enteric pathogens while uncovering a bacterial enzymatic mechanism for neutralizing host-targeted therapeutics.
papers.translated_summary: 肠致病性和肠出血性大肠杆菌（EPEC/EHEC）引起严重的全球性腹泻疾病，而日益加剧的抗菌药物耐药性使这一问题更加严峻。其致病机制依赖于附着与抹平病变，即细菌生成肌动蛋白基座以黏附、增殖并破坏肠道微绒毛。为鉴定靶向该过程的新型抗毒力候选物，我们开展了一项高通量表型筛选，通过高内涵荧光显微镜定量基座形成。我们鉴定出抗癌核苷酸类似物氯法拉滨是EPEC生长和致病性的强效抑制剂。与其肿瘤学机制——诱导DNA链终止和细胞凋亡——不同，氯法拉滨与细菌ATP依赖性过程竞争，从而阻碍基因转录、蛋白质合成和III型分泌系统（T3SS）功能。值得注意的是，EPEC通过切割氯法拉滨来对抗这种抑制，从而恢复蛋白质合成并恢复生长。此外，我们首次报道氯法拉滨抑制人单核细胞中的蛋白质翻译，提示其对哺乳动物细胞具有尚未阐明的翻译影响。这些发现揭示了宿主和细菌翻译作为嘌呤抗代谢物的相互关联的脆弱性，提供了一种解除肠道病原体武装的新策略，同时揭示了一种中和宿主靶向治疗药物的细菌酶学机制。

papers.title: Reliable prediction of short linear motifs in the human proteome
papers.translated_title: 人类蛋白质组中短线性基序的可靠预测
papers.author: Pancsa, R.
papers.summary: Short linear motifs (SLiMs) are small interaction modules within intrinsically disordered regions of proteins that interact with specific domains, and thereby regulate diverse biological processes. The limited information in SLiM definitions leads to frequent false positive hits in computational and experimental SLiM identification methods. Here, we refined the annotations of known motif classes to create a high-quality training dataset, and developed SLiMMine, a deep learning-based method to identify SLiMs in the human proteome. Relying on protein embeddings, SLiMMine outperforms similar approaches in identifying functional SLiMs, while eliminating ~80% of the pattern matching-based hits as false-positives. Furthermore, it can uncover novel SLiMs that do not fit known motif classes purely based on sequence features. Finally, narrowing the broad interactor-domain definitions of SLiM classes to specific partners enables more precise linking of predicted SLiMs to known protein-protein interactions. SLiMMine is available as a user-friendly, multi-purpose web server at https://slimmine.pbrg.hu/.
papers.translated_summary: 短线性基序（SLiMs）是蛋白质内在无序区域内的小型相互作用模块，它们与特定结构域相互作用，从而调控多种生物过程。SLiM定义中的信息有限，导致在计算和实验SLiM识别方法中频繁出现假阳性命中。在此，我们优化了已知基序类别的注释，以创建高质量的训练数据集，并开发了SLiMMine，一种基于深度学习的方法，用于识别人蛋白质组中的SLiMs。依托蛋白质嵌入，SLiMMine在识别功能性SLiMs方面优于类似方法，同时将约80%的基于模式匹配的命中作为假阳性消除。此外，它能够仅基于序列特征发现不符合已知基序类别的新SLiMs。最后，将SLiM类别宽泛的相互作用结构域定义缩小到特定伙伴，能够将预测的SLiMs与已知蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用更精确地关联起来。SLiMMine作为一个用户友好的多用途网络服务器可在https://slimmine.pbrg.hu/获取。

papers.title: Coupling Complementary Pathways in a Bacterial Co-culture Enables 4-Aminophenol Removal during Paracetamol Degradation
papers.translated_title: 细菌共培养中互补途径的耦合实现扑热息痛降解过程中的4-氨基苯酚去除
papers.author: Demaria, F.
papers.summary: Pharmaceutical biodegradation can generate potentially toxic metabolites that persist after the parent compound has been removed, posing additional risks to aquatic environments. Microbial co-cultures offer a promising strategy to address this challenge by combining complementary metabolic capabilities to remove both pharmaceuticals and their harmful transformation products by coupling complementary degradation pathways. Here, we investigated a two-species co-culture combining the paracetamol-degrading bacterium Delftia P1 with Microbacterium lacus to enable subsequent 4-AP removal. While Delftia P1 efficiently degraded paracetamol, it accumulated 4-AP as a dead-end metabolite. M. lacus was selected to complement this metabolic limitation because its genome contains a homolog of sadB, a monooxygenase gene involved in 4-AP transformation. The relative abundance of the two strains strongly influenced 4-AP removal, with the highest efficiency achieved at a Delftia P1:M. lacus cell-density ratio of 1:100, corresponding to an OD600nm ratio of 1:10. At this ratio, the co-culture achieved complete removal of paracetamol and 4-AP within 6 and 24 h, respectively. Its capacity was tested in wastewater, where 100% of paracetamol were removed within 4 h and no accumulation of 4-AP was observed within 24 h. These findings demonstrate the potential of cocultivating bacteria with complementary metabolic capabilities to address both pharmaceutical contamination and transformation-product accumulation. Moreover, the highest 4-AP removal was achieved when M. lacus was present at a 100-fold higher cell density than Delftia P1, highlighting the importance of considering relative cell densities when designing co-cultures.
papers.translated_summary: 药物生物降解可能产生潜在有毒的代谢物，这些代谢物在母体化合物被去除后仍持续存在，对水生环境构成额外风险。微生物共培养提供了一种有前景的策略来应对这一挑战，通过结合互补的代谢能力，偶联互补的降解途径，从而同时去除药物及其有害转化产物。在此，我们研究了一种由对乙酰氨基酚降解菌Delftia P1与Microbacterium lacus组成的两物种共培养体系，以实现后续4-AP的去除。Delftia P1能高效降解对乙酰氨基酚，但会积累4-AP作为死端代谢物。选择M. lacus来弥补这一代谢缺陷，是因为其基因组中含有sadB的同源基因，sadB是参与4-AP转化的单加氧酶基因。两株菌的相对丰度强烈影响4-AP的去除，在Delftia P1与M. lacus细胞密度比为1:100（对应OD600nm比为1:10）时去除效率最高。在该比例下，共培养体系分别在6 h和24 h内实现对乙酰氨基酚和4-AP的完全去除。其能力在废水中进行了测试，4 h内对乙酰氨基酚去除率达100%，且在24 h内未观察到4-AP的积累。这些发现证明了共培养具有互补代谢能力的细菌在应对药物污染和转化产物积累方面的潜力。此外，当M. lacus以比Delftia P1高100倍的细胞密度存在时，4-AP去除效果最佳，凸显了在设计共培养体系时考虑相对细胞密度的重要性。

papers.title: Infection-dependent antibiotic response phenotypes emerge during chronic airway adaptation of Pseudomonas aeruginosa
papers.translated_title: 感染依赖性抗生素应答表型在铜绿假单胞菌慢性气道适应过程中出现
papers.author: Laborda, P.
papers.summary: Objectives Chronic Pseudomonas aeruginosa airway infections can persist for years despite intensive antibiotic therapy guided by standard antimicrobial susceptibility testing. While this technique captures the emergence of resistance, it does not reproduce many features of the infection environment, where adaptation acquired during chronic infection may alter bacterial responses to antibiotics in ways that are not fully reflected by conventional susceptibility testing. Here we investigated antibiotic responses of longitudinal clinical isolates under standard laboratory conditions and in an airway epithelial infection model. Methods Six longitudinal pairs of P. aeruginosa isolates from people with cystic fibrosis were analysed. Changes in bacterial growth following exposure to tobramycin, ceftazidime and ciprofloxacin were quantified under standard laboratory conditions and compared with changes in bacterial burden after treatment measured in differentiated airway epithelial cultures maintained under air-liquid interface (ALI) conditions that reproduce key features of the airway infection environment. Representative phenotypes were visualized by confocal microscopy and interpreted in the context of available whole-genome sequencing data. Results Major resistance phenotypes identified by conventional susceptibility testing were largely reproduced in the ALI model. However, concordance between phenotypes observed under standard laboratory and ALI conditions differed between antibiotics. Several isolates classified as susceptible according to conventional susceptibility testing displayed substantial survival in the ALI model, and these discordant phenotypes were observed predominantly among those isolates recovered after prolonged airway persistence. Genomic analyses identified mutations associated with both classical resistance mechanisms and chronic adaptation. Conclusions Phenotypes observed under conventional laboratory conditions do not uniformly predict those observed in the ALI airway conditions. Discordant phenotypes were most apparent among chronically adapted isolates and varied between antibiotics, suggesting that adaptation acquired during chronic infection can alter antibiotic responses in ways that are not fully reflected by conventional susceptibility testing.
papers.translated_summary: 目的 慢性铜绿假单胞菌气道感染尽管接受了基于标准抗菌药物敏感性试验指导的强化抗生素治疗，仍可持续数年。虽然该技术能够捕捉耐药性的出现，但它无法再现感染环境的许多特征，在慢性感染期间获得的适应性变化可能以常规药敏试验未能完全反映的方式改变细菌对 antibiotics 的应答。本研究在标准实验室条件和气道上皮感染模型中，研究了纵向临床分离株的抗生素应答。方法 分析了来自囊性纤维化患者的6对纵向铜绿假单胞菌分离株。在标准实验室条件下，量化了暴露于妥布霉素、头孢他啶和环丙沙星后细菌生长的变化，并与在气液界面（ALI）条件下维持的分化气道上皮培养物中治疗后细菌载量的变化进行比较，该条件再现了气道感染环境的关键特征。通过共聚焦显微镜观察代表性表型，并结合可用的全基因组测序数据进行解读。结果 通过常规药敏试验识别的主要耐药表型在ALI模型中基本得到再现。然而，标准实验室条件与ALI条件下观察到的表型之间的一致性因抗生素而异。若干根据常规药敏试验被归类为敏感的分离株在ALI模型中表现出显著存活，这些不一致的表型主要见于气道持续存在较长时间后回收的分离株。基因组分析识别出与经典耐药机制和慢性适应性变化均相关的突变。结论 在常规实验室条件下观察到的表型不能一致地预测在ALI气道条件下观察到的表型。不一致的表型在慢性适应分离株中最为明显，并因抗生素而异，提示慢性感染期间获得的适应性变化可以以常规药敏试验未能完全反映的方式改变抗生素应答。

papers.title: Flexible phosphorus allocation to the phosphoproteome underpins diatom regulatory adaptations to fluctuating phosphate supply
papers.translated_title: 磷蛋白组中灵活的磷分配是硅藻对波动性磷酸盐供应进行调控适应的基础
papers.author: Meeda, Y.
papers.summary: Diatoms are major drivers of marine phosphorus (P) cycling and are highly adapted to cope with variable P supply. P-starved diatoms can sense increases in P availability within seconds, accumulating this limiting resource through luxury polyphosphate (polyP) storage. Yet, how diatoms coordinate such responses is unknown. Protein phosphorylation is a core mechanism for environmental signal transduction in eukaryotes, but how cells balance investment in protein phosphorylation against competing physiological demands during P limitation is poorly understood. Here, we characterise system-wide remodelling of the Phaeodactylum tricornutum phosphoproteome in response to P deficiency and subsequent resupply. We identify widespread proteome dephosphorylation across 44% of phosphosites, revealing a previously unrecognised P-sparing strategy in marine phytoplankton. Following P resupply, diatoms orchestrate extensive phosphoproteome reprogramming within minutes. We characterise previously unrecognized components for early recovery from P limitation, including a novel environmentally prevalent intracellular H+/phosphate transporter strongly conserved in diverse diatoms. We also identify a vacuolar Ca2+-dependent protein kinase (CDPK) associated with polyP-storage granules. Mutant and inhibitor analyses demonstrate a role for Ca2+- and CDPK-signalling in the regulation of luxury polyP accumulation. Our findings reveal that recovery from P starvation is mediated by rapid phosphoregulatory control of intracellular P trafficking, organellar ATP generation coupled with luxury P storage, enabling diatoms to exploit newly available P and thrive in fluctuating P regimes. Collectively, our study uncovers the phosphoproteome as a flexible intracellular P reservoir and establishes mechanistic links between intracellular P budgeting, signalling and the marine P cycle.
papers.translated_summary: 硅藻是海洋磷（P）循环的主要驱动者，并高度适应应对多变的磷供应。磷饥饿的硅藻能在数秒内感知磷有效性的增加，通过奢侈性多聚磷酸（polyP）储存来积累这一限制性资源。然而，硅藻如何协调这些响应尚不清楚。蛋白质磷酸化是真核生物环境信号转导的核心机制，但细胞在磷限制期间如何平衡对蛋白质磷酸化的投入与竞争性生理需求，目前知之甚少。在此，我们表征了三角褐指藻（Phaeodactylum tricornutum）磷酸化蛋白质组在响应磷缺乏及随后再供应过程中的系统级重塑。我们鉴定出广泛存在的蛋白质组去磷酸化，覆盖44%的磷酸化位点，揭示了海洋浮游植物中一种此前未被认识的磷节约策略。在磷再供应后，硅藻在数分钟内 orchestrate 广泛的磷酸化蛋白质组重编程。我们表征了此前未被认识的磷限制早期恢复组分，包括一种在多种硅藻中高度保守的新型环境普遍存在的细胞内H+/磷酸盐转运蛋白。我们还鉴定了一种与polyP储存颗粒相关的液泡Ca2+依赖性蛋白激酶（CDPK）。突变体和抑制剂分析证明了Ca2+和CDPK信号在奢侈性polyP积累调控中的作用。我们的发现揭示，磷饥饿恢复是由细胞内磷运输的快速磷酸化调控、细胞器ATP生成 coupled with 奢侈性磷储存所介导的，使硅藻能够利用新可用的磷并在波动的磷 regime 中繁荣。总之，我们的研究揭示了磷酸化蛋白质组作为一种灵活的细胞内磷储库，并建立了细胞内磷预算、信号传导与海洋磷循环之间的机制联系。

papers.title: Engineered Miniature ParTasR Enables Efficient PAMless Genome Editing
papers.translated_title: 工程化微型ParTasR实现高效无PAM基因组编辑
papers.author: Zhang, X.
papers.summary: TIGR-Tas system holds great promise for genome-engineering applications owing to its compact size and PAMless targeting capability. However, its low editing efficiency in mammalian cells severely limits its broader utility. Here, we engineered a highly active variant of ParTasR, termed eTasR, through structure-guided rational design of ParTasR combined with fusion to the exonuclease TREX2. eTasR increased mammalian editing efficiency from the original 4.29% to 48.94% with an average 26.52-fold increase, significantly surpassing the efficiency of SpRY, a reported version of PAM-free nuclease. More importantly, single-AAV delivery enabled efficient Hpd disruption in vivo, resulting in robust phenotypic rescue. Thus, eTasR provides a compact, PAMless and highly efficient platform for genome editing and therapeutic applications.
papers.translated_summary: TIGR-Tas系统因其紧凑的尺寸和无PAM靶向能力，在基因组工程应用中具有巨大潜力。然而，其在哺乳动物细胞中的低编辑效率严重限制了其更广泛的用途。在此，我们通过结构引导的ParTasR理性设计，并结合融合核酸外切酶TREX2，工程化改造出一种高活性的ParTasR变体，命名为eTasR。eTasR将哺乳动物编辑效率从原始的4.29%提高至48.94%，平均提升26.52倍，显著超越了已报道的无PAM核酸酶SpRY的效率。更重要的是，单AAV递送能够在体内实现高效的Hpd破坏，从而产生稳健的表型挽救。因此，eTasR为基因组编辑和治疗应用提供了一个紧凑、无PAM且高效的平台。

papers.title: Positive selection tends to act on exposed extracellular regions and delineate interaction modules targeted by pathogens
papers.translated_title: 正选择往往作用于暴露的细胞外区域，并界定病原体所靶向的相互作用模块。
papers.author: Dobson, L.
papers.summary: Background: Positive selection shapes protein function by favoring amino acid substitutions that increase fitness. Although numerous studies have identified positively selected genes (PSGs), the structural principles underlying residue-level positive selection remain incompletely understood and previous studies have produced conflicting conclusions, particularly regarding the preferential location of positively selected residues (PSRs) within intrinsically disordered regions. In order to resolve these issues and to better understand the driving forces underlying positive selection in human proteins, we performed a comprehensive analysis on a manually curated, high quality collection of PSGs and PSRs as well as on a large-scale PSR dataset restricted to proteins with experimental structures. Results: Human PSRs were significantly enriched in secreted and cell membrane proteins and preferentially localized to extracellular regions, solvent-exposed protein surfaces, coil structures, and protein-protein interaction interfaces, whereas neither domains nor intrinsically disordered regions showed an enrichment. Spatial clustering analysis reinforced that PSRs accumulate within localized surface patches. Integration of host-pathogen interaction data highlighted that adaptive changes preferentially affect extracellular molecular recognition surfaces, recurrently appearing in certain pathogen-interacting membrane protein families and particular domain types. Additionally, PSRs showed an enrichment in the residues of human-pathogen interaction interfaces that are in direct contact with pathogenic proteins, implying that neutralizing pathogen attacks is one of the driving forces behind the adaptive evolution of human proteins. By analysing human variation data we found that PSRs are enriched in benign but depleted in pathogenic substitutions, extending previous observations that positively selected genes contain elevated levels of missense variation. Notably, PSGs of the large-scale dataset were also enriched among clinical-stage drug targets, suggesting a potential link between positive selection and pharmacological relevance. Conclusion: Together, our results provide a refined structural model of adaptive evolution in human proteins and identify extracellular exposed molecular recognition surfaces and human-pathogen interaction interfaces as recurrent hotspots of positive selection. Our results point to the direction that precise identification of human PSRs could delineate important host-pathogen interfaces that exert evolutionary selection pressure on humans and appoint novel targets with therapeutic potential.
papers.translated_summary: 背景：正选择通过偏好能提高适合度的氨基酸替换来塑造蛋白质功能。尽管大量研究已鉴定出正选择基因（PSGs），但残基水平正选择的结构原理仍未被完全理解，且既往研究得出了相互矛盾的结论，尤其是关于正选择残基（PSRs）在内在无序区中的偏好定位问题。为解决这些问题并更好地理解人类蛋白质正选择背后的驱动力，我们对人工整理的高质量PSGs和PSRs集合，以及限制于具有实验结构的蛋白质的大规模PSR数据集，进行了全面分析。结果：人类PSRs在分泌蛋白和细胞膜蛋白中显著富集，并优先定位于胞外区域、溶剂暴露的蛋白质表面、卷曲结构以及蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用界面，而结构域和内在无序区均未显示富集。空间聚类分析进一步证实，PSRs聚集于局部表面斑块内。整合宿主-病原体相互作用数据突出表明，适应性变化优先影响胞外分子识别表面，反复出现在某些病原体相互作用的膜蛋白家族和特定结构域类型中。此外，PSRs在人类-病原体相互作用界面中与病原体蛋白直接接触的残基中显示富集，暗示中和病原体攻击是人类蛋白质适应性进化的驱动力之一。通过分析人类变异数据，我们发现PSRs在良性替换中富集而在致病性替换中耗竭，扩展了既往观察，即正选择基因含有较高水平的错义变异。值得注意的是，大规模数据集中的PSGs也在临床阶段药物靶点中富集，提示正选择与药理学相关性之间可能存在联系。结论：总之，我们的结果提供了人类蛋白质适应性进化的精细结构模型，并确定胞外暴露的分子识别表面和人类-病原体相互作用界面为正选择的反复热点。我们的结果指向这样一个方向：精确鉴定人类PSRs可能勾勒出对人类施加进化选择压力的重要宿主-病原体界面，并指定具有治疗潜力的新靶点。

papers.title: Parallel enterocyte caspase and cytokine responses couple hypoxia to reoxygenation-dependent intestinal regeneration in Drosophila
papers.translated_title: 平行肠上皮细胞caspase与细胞因子反应将缺氧与果蝇中依赖复氧的肠道再生相耦合
papers.author: Bodkhe, P.
papers.summary: Intestinal oxygen availability fluctuates during both normal physiology and disease, yet how the intestinal epithelium adapts to these changing environments remains poorly understood. Using the adult Drosophila intestine, we show that hypoxia and reoxygenation drive distinct phases of an epithelial damage and repair response. Hypoxia induces two parallel responses in largely separate enterocyte populations: an AMPK-p53-dependent response that primes enterocytes for apoptosis, and an independent Upd cytokine response that activates JAK-STAT signaling in intestinal stem cells (ISCs). Despite activation of both pathways during hypoxia, neither apoptosis nor ISC proliferation occurs until oxygen is restored. Upon reoxygenation, enterocyte loss and ISC proliferation proceed together and both are required for recovery of intestinal length. We further show that HIF-1/Sima is dispensable in enterocytes but required in progenitor cells for reoxygenation-induced proliferation. Finally, repeated episodes of hypoxia-reoxygenation shorten lifespan, and this is exacerbated by enterocyte p53 knockdown. Together, these findings indicate that the epithelium adapts to fluctuating oxygen by coordinating damage and repair responses in space and time.
papers.translated_summary: 肠道氧气可利用度在正常生理和疾病状态下均会波动，然而肠上皮如何适应这些变化的环境仍知之甚少。利用成体黑腹果蝇肠道，我们发现缺氧和复氧驱动上皮损伤与修复反应的不同阶段。缺氧在 largely 分离的肠细胞群体中诱导两条平行反应：一条AMPK-p53依赖性反应使肠细胞准备进入凋亡，以及一条独立的Upd细胞因子反应激活肠道干细胞（ISCs）中的JAK-STAT信号传导。尽管缺氧期间两条通路均被激活，但凋亡和ISC增殖在氧气恢复之前均不发生。复氧后，肠细胞丢失和ISC增殖共同进行，且两者均为肠道长度恢复所必需。我们进一步表明，HIF-1/Sima在肠细胞中可有可无，但在祖细胞中对复氧诱导的增殖是必需的。最后，反复的缺氧-复氧事件缩短寿命，而肠细胞p53敲低会加剧这一效应。总之，这些发现表明上皮通过在空间和时间上协调损伤与修复反应来适应波动的氧气。

papers.title: A Framework For Reconstruction And Analysis Of Extended Pedigrees From Large-Scale Genealogy And Archive Records
papers.translated_title: 大规模谱系与档案记录中扩展家系的 reconstruction 与分析框架
papers.author: van Oosten, D.
papers.summary: Genetic analyses in pedigrees remain a powerful approach to identify rare disease-causing variants. Reconstructing large enough pedigrees to yield sufficient power, however, still faces challenges. Clinical family histories are often incomplete, especially in late-onset diseases caused by genetic variants with incomplete penetrance. Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) is such a disease with a disproportionately large contribution from rare variants with high but variable penetrance. Here, we present an open-source pipeline to reconstruct extended pedigrees from large-scale archive data dating back to ~1800, which we applied to a cohort of Dutch ALS patients carrying the C9orf72 hexanucleotide repeat expansion (HRE). Among 238 C9orf72 HRE carriers, 91 (38%) were members of an extended pedigree. Of these, 48 (53%) were clinically classified as sporadic ALS. In total, we identified 39 extended pedigrees including affected relatives up to the eighth degree of relatedness. Our approach increased the number of identified relationships by 2.5-fold compared with clinically obtained family histories, that typically missed relationships beyond the third degree. Genome-wide IBD analysis in pedigrees with [≥]7 meioses fine-mapped the C9orf72 HRE to shared IBD segments spanning 10.2 - 127.0 centimorgans in 97% of pedigrees. This combined genealogical-genetic approach for large-scale reconstruction of extended pedigrees supports the reclassification of apparently sporadic cases, facilitates the discovery of new disease-causing variants in ALS, and is applicable to any disease with comparable genetic architecture.
papers.translated_summary: 家系中的遗传分析仍然是识别罕见致病变异的强大方法。然而，重建足够大的家系以获得足够效力仍面临挑战。临床家族史往往不完整，尤其是由不完全外显的遗传变异引起的晚发性疾病。肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）就是这样一种疾病，其贡献不成比例地来自具有高但可变外显率的罕见变异。在此，我们提出一个开源流程，用于从可追溯至约1800年的大规模档案数据中重建扩展家系，并将其应用于携带C9orf72六核苷酸重复扩增（HRE）的荷兰ALS患者队列。在238名C9orf72 HRE携带者中，91名（38%）是某个扩展家系的成员。其中，48名（53%）在临床上被归类为散发性ALS。我们总共识别出39个扩展家系，包括亲缘关系远至第八度的受累亲属。与临床获得的家族史相比，我们的方法将识别出的关系数量增加了2.5倍，而临床家族史通常遗漏三度以外的关系。在具有≥7次减数分裂的家系中进行全基因组IBD分析，将C9orf72 HRE精细定位到97%的家系中跨越10.2–127.0厘摩的共享IBD片段。这种用于大规模重建扩展家系的系谱-遗传学联合方法支持对明显散发性病例进行重新分类，有助于在ALS中发现新的致病变异，并适用于任何具有可比遗传结构的疾病。

papers.title: Risk-Based Cardiovascular-Kidney-Metabolic Staging Identifies a Population With Mortality Comparable to Established Cardiovascular Disease: Disability-Adjusted Life Years Across AHA Stages, 2005 to 2023
papers.translated_title: 基于风险的心血管-肾脏-代谢分期识别出死亡率与确诊心血管疾病相当的人群：2005至2023年AHA各分期的伤残调整生命年
papers.author: Wang, X.
papers.summary: Background: Cardiovascular-kidney-metabolic (CKM) syndrome was defined in 2023 as a five-stage continuum, with stage 3 assigned on predicted rather than established cardiovascular disease. Whether that stage identifies a population whose mortality resembles clinical disease, and how health loss is distributed across stages, is unknown. Methods: We pooled nine National Health and Nutrition Examination Survey cycles (2005-2023) and assigned CKM stages 0-4 from measured risk factors, kidney function, urine albumin, self-reported cardiovascular disease, and 10-year PREVENT risk. Years lived with disability used Global Burden of Disease weights; years of life lost combined national death counts, linked mortality files, and period life tables. Results: In 2021-2023, stage prevalence was 13.8% (stage 0), 21.3% (stage 1), 49.1% (stage 2), 6.5% (stage 3), and 9.3% (stage 4). Crude mortality was 6,709 per 100,000 person-years in stage 3, comparable to 6,375 in stage 4. Adjusted hazard ratios rose from 1.39 in stage 2 to 3.22 in stage 4, with no excess in stage 1 (0.99). CKM accounted for 20.0 million DALYs annually, with 76% of attributable years of life lost in stages 3-4 (15.8% of adults). Lipid-lowering therapy was absent in 53.7% of stage 3 and 33.6% of stage 4 adults. Stage 0 prevalence fell 2.3% per year and stage 1 rose 3.1% per year between 2006 and 2016. Conclusions: Risk-based stage 3 carries short-term mortality indistinguishable from established cardiovascular disease, yet the population continues to shift into stage 1, where mortality is normal, and stage 3 receives less intensive lipid-lowering treatment than stage 4.
papers.translated_summary: 背景：心血管-肾脏-代谢（CKM）综合征于2023年被定义为一个五阶段连续体，其中第3阶段依据预测而非已确立的心血管疾病来划分。该阶段所识别的人群其死亡率是否与临床疾病相似，以及健康损失在各阶段之间如何分布，尚不清楚。方法：我们汇总了九个全国健康与营养调查周期（2005-2023），依据测量的危险因素、肾功能、尿白蛋白、自我报告的心血管疾病以及10年PREVENT风险，将CKM阶段划分为0-4阶段。伤残损失健康生命年采用全球疾病负担权重；寿命损失年则综合了全国死亡计数、关联死亡档案和时期生命表。结果：2021-2023年，各阶段患病率分别为13.8%（第0阶段）、21.3%（第1阶段）、49.1%（第2阶段）、6.5%（第3阶段）和9.3%（第4阶段）。第3阶段的粗死亡率为每10万人年6,709例，与第4阶段的6,375例相当。调整后风险比从第2阶段的1.39升至第4阶段的3.22，第1阶段无超额风险（0.99）。CKM每年造成2,000万伤残调整生命年，其中76%的归因寿命损失年集中在第3-4阶段（占成人的15.8%）。第3阶段有53.7%、第4阶段有33.6%的成人未接受降脂治疗。2006年至2016年间，第0阶段患病率每年下降2.3%，第1阶段每年上升3.1%。结论：基于风险划分的第3阶段，其短期死亡率与已确立的心血管疾病难以区分，然而人群仍在持续向死亡率正常的第1阶段转移，且第3阶段接受的降脂治疗强度低于第4阶段。

papers.title: Diversifying deaths: the shifting spectrum of childhood respiratory infectious mortality, 1990-2023: a systematic analysis of the Global Burden of Disease Study 2023
papers.translated_title: 死亡谱系的多样化：1990-2023年儿童呼吸道感染性死亡率的变迁：2023年全球疾病负担研究的系统分析
papers.author: Li, D.
papers.summary: Background Childhood respiratory infectious deaths are partitioned across four Global Burden of Disease cause modules-26 etiological attributions within lower respiratory infections, tuberculosis, COVID-19, and whooping cough-never jointly reported. Whether the structure of this combined mortality spectrum has changed over time, and with what implications for intervention design, has not been quantified. We assembled and analyzed the integrated spectrum for children and adolescents aged 0-19 years, 1990-2023. Methods We integrated Global Burden of Disease Study 2023 (release v8352) estimates into a 29-node spectrum-26 lower respiratory infection etiologies plus tuberculosis, COVID-19, and pertussis-globally and across seven super-regions, with uncertainty propagated by summing bounds. We computed Shannon diversity, Herfindahl concentration, and effective cause counts; phenotyped pandemic-window collapse and rebound per cause; linked pathogen shares to WHO/UNICEF vaccine coverage; and mapped geographic concentration in sub-Saharan Africa and South Asia. Reporting follows GATHER. Segmented (joinpoint) log-linear models with breakpoints selected by the Bayesian information criterion were fitted to annual totals, Shannon diversity and leading pathogen shares. Results In 2023 the 29 causes jointly accounted for 965,330 deaths (95% uncertainty interval [UI] 680,096-1,342,437). Shannon diversity rose from 2.336 to 2.711 (+16.1%) between 1990 and 2023; the effective number of causes nearly doubled (5.57 to 9.94), inversely coupled to total deaths (Spearman rho = -0.997). Whooping cough ranked second (112,954 deaths; 95% UI 64,576-185,708; 11.7%) and showed the spectrum's only rebound above 100% (-57.4% collapse, +111.0% rebound). Tuberculosis ranked third (87,764; 57,779-124,912; 9.1%) with the highest concentration in sub-Saharan Africa and South Asia (87.1%). COVID-19 entered at rank five (52,899; 47,275-59,183; 5.5%). Nineteen of 29 causes exceeded the poverty-lock threshold (>80.59% of deaths in sub-Saharan Africa plus South Asia). Joinpoint analysis placed breakpoints in total deaths at 2011, 2018 and 2021-the decline slowed from -3.4% to -2.3% per year after 2011, steepened to -7.1% per year in 2018-2021 and rebounded +4.5% per year in 2021-2023-while diversification accelerated to +1.18% per year in 2013-2020; all six leading pathogen shares carried a pandemic-window breakpoint at 2019 and 2021 (S. pneumoniae at 2018 and 2021). Conclusions Childhood respiratory infectious mortality has become more diverse and more concentrated in poverty as it has declined. Single-pathogen interventions now address a shrinking share; the spectrum's structure argues for platform interventions-oxygen, antimicrobial access, referral-tailored jointly by age and geography, implying that pathogen-specific strategies alone cannot finish the remaining mortality agenda.
papers.translated_summary: 背景 儿童呼吸道感染死亡被划分在四个全球疾病负担病因模块中——下呼吸道感染内部的26种病因归因、结核病、COVID-19和百日咳——从未联合报告。这一合并死亡谱的结构是否随时间发生变化，以及对干预设计有何启示，尚未被量化。我们组装并分析了1990—2023年0—19岁儿童和青少年的整合死亡谱。方法 我们将全球疾病负担研究2023（发布版v8352）的估计值整合为一个29节点死亡谱——26种下呼吸道感染病因加上结核病、COVID-19和百日咳——在全球及七个超级区域层面，并通过求和上下界传播不确定性。我们计算了Shannon多样性、Herfindahl集中度和有效病因数；对每种病因在大流行窗口期的崩塌和反弹进行了表型分析；将病原体份额与WHO/UNICEF疫苗覆盖率相关联；并绘制了撒哈拉以南非洲和南亚的地理集中度。报告遵循GATHER规范。对年度总数、Shannon多样性和主要病原体份额拟合了分段（joinpoint）对数线性模型，断点由贝叶斯信息准则选择。结果 2023年，29种病因合计造成965,330例死亡（95%不确定性区间[UI] 680,096—1,342,437）。Shannon多样性从1990年的2.336升至2023年的2.711（+16.1%）；有效病因数几乎翻倍（5.57至9.94），与总死亡数呈反向耦合（Spearman rho = -0.997）。百日咳位列第二（112,954例死亡；95% UI 64,576—185,708；11.7%），并表现出该死亡谱中唯一超过100%的反弹（崩塌-57.4%，反弹+111.0%）。结核病位列第三（87,764；57,779—124,912；9.1%），在撒哈拉以南非洲和南亚的集中度最高（87.1%）。COVID-19以第五位进入（52,899；47,275—59,183；5.5%）。29种病因中有19种超过了贫困锁定阈值（>80.59%的死亡发生在撒哈拉以南非洲加南亚）。Joinpoint分析将总死亡数的断点置于2011年、2018年和2021年——2011年后下降速度从每年-3.4%放缓至-2.3%，2018—2021年陡增至每年-7.1%，2021—2023年反弹至每年+4.5%——而多样化在2013—2020年加速至每年+1.18%；所有六种主要病原体份额均在2019年和2021年出现大流行窗口断点（肺炎链球菌在2018年和2021年）。结论 儿童呼吸道感染死亡在下降的同时变得更加多样、更加集中于贫困地区。单一病原体干预现在所针对的份额正在缩小；该死亡谱的结构支持平台型干预——氧气、抗菌药物可及性、转诊——按年龄和地理区域联合定制，这意味着仅靠病原体特异性策略无法完成剩余的死亡议程。

papers.title: Transdiagnostic gray matter volume reductions implicating social dysfunction in depression, schizophrenia, and alcohol use disorder: A neuroimaging meta-analysis
papers.translated_title: 跨诊断灰质体积减少提示抑郁症、精神分裂症和酒精使用障碍中的社会功能障碍：一项神经影像学元分析
papers.author: Bore, M. C.
papers.summary: Anhedonia, social withdrawal and executive deficits represent transdiagnostic symptoms in depression, schizophrenia and addiction, yet transdiagnostic brain volumetric alterations and their contribution to these symptom domains have not been systematically characterized. Here, we capitalized on a pre-registered (https://osf.io/s57uq) coordinate-based meta-analysis across 147 VBM studies (n=13,041) to determine common and disorder-specific gray matter deficits in patients with schizophrenia (90 studies), major depression disorder (44 studies) and alcohol use disorder (13 studies). Original case-control articles comparing patients with healthy controls, published in English and reporting whole-brain results were included. We found shared GMV alterations in the ventromedial prefrontal cortex, ventral anterior cingulate cortex, insula, superior temporal gyrus. On the network level, we found robust functional interactions of the identified shared regions with the cortical midline structures as well as social and theory of mind-related behavioral functions. Subsequent characterization analyses highlighted the involvement of dopaminergic and serotonergic neurotransmitters as well as associated genetic annotations. Overall, the present meta-analysis found common as well as separate GMV abnormalities in schizophrenia, major depressive disorder and alcohol use disorder suggesting a common neurostructural substrate and treatment target for social withdrawal and anhedonia across these disorders. Keywords: alcohol-use disorder, depression, meta-analysis, schizophrenia, voxel-based morphometry
papers.translated_summary: 快感缺失、社交退缩和执行功能缺陷是抑郁症、精神分裂症和成瘾中的跨诊断症状，然而跨诊断的脑体积改变及其对这些症状域的贡献尚未被系统描述。在此，我们利用一项预注册的（https://osf.io/s57uq）基于坐标的元分析，涵盖147项VBM研究（n=13,041），以确定精神分裂症（90项研究）、重性抑郁障碍（44项研究）和酒精使用障碍（13项研究）患者中共同的和疾病特异性的灰质缺陷。纳入标准为比较患者与健康对照的原始病例对照文章，以英文发表并报告全脑结果。我们发现腹内侧前额叶皮层、腹侧前扣带皮层、岛叶、颞上回存在共享的GMV改变。在网络层面，我们发现所识别的共享区域与皮层中线结构以及社会和心智理论相关的行为功能之间存在稳健的功能交互。随后的特征分析强调了多巴胺能和血清素能神经递质的参与以及相关的基因注释。总体而言，本元分析发现精神分裂症、重性抑郁障碍和酒精使用障碍中存在共同以及独立的GMV异常，提示这些疾病中社交退缩和快感缺失存在共同的神经结构基础和治療靶点。关键词：酒精使用障碍，抑郁症，元分析，精神分裂症，基于体素的形态学分析

papers.title: Automated Patient Identity Verification Framework for Multimodal Medical Imaging Using Deep Metric Learning and Domain Adaptation
papers.translated_title: 基于深度度量学习和域适应的多模态医学影像自动化患者身份验证框架
papers.author: Ueda, Y.
papers.summary: Purpose: Patient identity management is fundamental in healthcare information systems, as identification inconsistencies can compromise patient safety, data integrity, and clinical workflow efficiency. Reliable linkage of medical images acquired across different imaging modalities remains challenging because of variations in image appearance, acquisition geometry, and imaging characteristics. In this study, we developed an automated patient identity verification framework for multimodal medical imaging using deep metric learning and data-augmented domain adaptation (DADA). Methods: The proposed framework learned modality-invariant patient representations from labeled source-domain data while leveraging unlabeled target-domain data to mitigate cross-modality distribution shifts. Although patient identity annotations were available within the research dataset for evaluation purposes, target-domain labels were intentionally excluded from the DADA optimization process. Chest radiographs and computed tomography (CT) scout images obtained under routine clinical conditions were retrospectively collected and used for evaluation. Verification performance was assessed using receiver operating characteristic (ROC) analysis, with the area under the ROC curve (AUC) used as the primary performance metric. Results: The proposed framework achieved consistently high verification performance across all evaluation conditions, with AUC values ranging from 0.9989 to 0.9999. Similarity-score distributions demonstrated distinct separation between same-patient and different-patient image pairs despite substantial differences between imaging modalities. Conclusion: These findings indicate that patient-specific anatomical representations can be preserved across heterogeneous imaging domains through metric learning and domain adaptation. The proposed framework may serve as a practical infrastructure component for patient identity management, multimodal data integration, quality assurance, and patient safety applications within healthcare information systems.
papers.translated_summary: 目的：患者身份管理是医疗信息系统的基础，因为身份识别不一致可能危及患者安全、数据完整性和临床工作流程效率。由于图像外观、采集几何结构和成像特征的差异，跨不同成像模态获取的医学图像的可靠关联仍然具有挑战性。在本研究中，我们开发了一个自动化患者身份验证框架，用于多模态医学成像，采用深度度量学习和数据增强域适应（DADA）。方法：所提出的框架从有标记的源域数据中学习模态不变的患者表征，同时利用无标记的目标域数据来缓解跨模态分布偏移。尽管研究数据集中存在患者身份标注用于评估目的，但目标域标签被有意排除在DADA优化过程之外。回顾性收集了在常规临床条件下获得的胸部X线摄影和计算机断层扫描（CT）定位像，并用于评估。验证性能通过受试者工作特征（ROC）分析进行评估，以ROC曲线下面积（AUC）作为主要性能指标。结果：所提出的框架在所有评估条件下均实现了持续的高验证性能，AUC值范围为0.9989至0.9999。尽管成像模态之间存在显著差异，相似度分数分布在同患者和不同患者图像对之间表现出明显分离。结论：这些发现表明，通过度量学习和域适应，患者特异性解剖表征可以在异构成像域之间得以保留。所提出的框架可作为医疗信息系统中患者身份管理、多模态数据集成、质量保证和患者安全应用的实用基础设施组件。

papers.title: Fighting Addictions, improving Lives through COmprehensive drug rehabilitation with music (FALCO): Protocol for an international randomised controlled trial
papers.translated_title: 通过音乐综合戒毒康复抗击成瘾、改善生活（FALCO）：一项国际随机对照试验的方案
papers.author: Geretsegger, M.
papers.summary: Background: Substance use disorders (SUD) are associated with a high global burden of disease, with 5.4% of all disability-adjusted life years lost due to alcohol and illicit drugs. Highly prevalent multimorbidity includes polysubstance use, mental health conditions, and other non-communicable and infectious diseases. Where traditional treatments are insufficient alone, music therapy (MT) is highly engaging and improves motivation and reduces craving; however, its long-term effects are unknown. The present study aims to examine long-term effects of active music groups (AMG) and music listening groups (MLG) versus treatment as usual (TAU) on addiction severity, recovery, and other outcomes in people with SUD Immediate and short-term effects, as well as mechanisms of these interventions, will also be examined. Methods: In individuals with SUD across a wide range of age, gender, socioeconomic, and cultural backgrounds, a parallel 3-arm assessor-blinded pragmatic multinational randomised controlled trial (RCT) with embedded exploratory trials and mechanistic studies will determine long-term effects of AMG and MLG versus TAU on addiction severity (primary endpoint: 1 year), recovery, and other outcomes. Embedded trials will examine immediate effects of AMG or MLG combined with individual components of TAU combined to determine the best combinations of interventions. Experimental studies will examine mechanisms using cognitive testing and brain imaging. With 600 participants in 7 countries randomised, the trial will have 80% power on the primary outcome. Patient representatives, health technology assessment (HTA) bodies, and interventionists have been involved from conception and will ensure feasibility and applicability of the intervention across Europe. Discussion: This document describes the FALCO RCT, the main part of the FALCO project, which aims to reduce disease burden through innovative, effective, and affordable treatment, and will strengthen research and innovation expertise. Recommendations from FALCO will inform intervention delivery across Europe and beyond, leading to increased safety, effectiveness, and cost-effectiveness, and improved quality of life for individuals with SUD. Stakeholders will be involved in communicating findings across all European countries and regions and ensuring that findings are effectively implemented. Trial registration: ClinicalTrials.gov, NCT07028983, registered 11th of June 2025. https://clinicaltrials.gov/study/NCT07028983
papers.translated_summary: 背景：物质使用障碍（SUD）与全球高疾病负担相关，酒精和非法药物导致所有伤残调整生命年的5.4%损失。高度流行的多病共存包括多物质使用、精神健康状况以及其他非传染性和传染性疾病。在传统治疗单独不足的情况下，音乐治疗（MT）具有高度参与性，可提高动机并减少渴求；然而，其长期效果尚不清楚。本研究旨在考察主动音乐团体（AMG）和音乐聆听团体（MLG）与常规治疗（TAU）相比对SUD患者成瘾严重程度、康复及其他结局的长期效果。这些干预的即时和短期效果以及机制也将被考察。方法：在年龄、性别、社会经济和文化背景广泛的SUD个体中，一项平行3臂评估者盲法实用性多国随机对照试验（RCT），嵌入探索性试验和机制研究，将确定AMG和MLG与TAU相比对成瘾严重程度（主要终点：1年）、康复及其他结局的长期效果。嵌入试验将考察AMG或MLG与TAU各组成部分联合的即时效果，以确定最佳干预组合。实验研究将使用认知测试和脑成像考察机制。该试验在7个国家随机分配600名参与者，主要结局将具有80%的把握度。患者代表、卫生技术评估（HTA）机构和干预实施者从构思阶段即参与，并将确保干预在欧洲各地的可行性和适用性。讨论：本文描述FALCO RCT，即FALCO项目的主要部分，旨在通过创新、有效和可负担的治疗减少疾病负担，并将加强研究和创新专业知识。FALCO的建议将为欧洲及其他地区的干预实施提供信息，从而提高安全性、有效性和成本效益，并改善SUD个体的生活质量。利益相关者将参与在所有欧洲国家和地区的研究结果传播，并确保研究结果得到有效实施。试验注册：ClinicalTrials.gov，NCT07028983，于2025年6月11日注册。https://clinicaltrials.gov/study/NCT07028983

papers.title: Human Plasma Proteomics Links Modifiable Lifestyle Exposome to Disease Risk
papers.translated_title: 人类血浆蛋白质组学将可改变的生活方式暴露组与疾病风险联系起来
papers.author: Isaac, S. K.
papers.summary: Lifestyle exposures influence disease risk, yet the molecular signatures linking modifiable behaviors to human biology remain incompletely characterized. Here we show that the plasma proteome carries a measurable record of modifiable lifestyle exposures. We developed the Human Exposomic Architecture of the Proteome (HEAP), a framework linking lifestyle exposures, plasma proteins, and disease risk at population scale. Applying HEAP to more than 50,000 UK Biobank participants, 2,686 plasma proteins, and 169 lifestyle exposures, we identified exposure-associated protein signatures that organized along shared health-behavior patterns and connected lifestyle variation to disease-relevant biology. Integrating disease associations, mediation analyses, Mendelian randomization, and colocalization showed that only a minority of exposure-responsive proteins were consistent with causal intermediates, whereas many appeared to function as biological reporters of exposure burden, disease liability, and early disease processes. Comparisons with exercise-training and glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor agonist studies linked observational lifestyle signatures to intervention-induced proteomic changes, suggesting that part of the exposomic signal reflects biology modifiable by intervention. Furthermore, proteome-based exposure scores captured exposure-associated biology, tracked behavioral change over time, and predicted disease risk. Overall, HEAP provides a resource for advancing disease prevention and precision medicine by linking modifiable lifestyle exposures to disease-relevant protein signatures.
papers.translated_summary: 生活方式暴露影响疾病风险，但将可改变行为与人类生物学联系起来的分子特征仍未得到充分表征。本研究表明，血浆蛋白质组携带可测量的可改变生活方式暴露记录。我们开发了蛋白质组的人类暴露组架构（HEAP），这是一个在人群尺度上连接生活方式暴露、血浆蛋白和疾病风险的框架。将HEAP应用于超过50,000名英国生物银行参与者、2,686种血浆蛋白和169种生活方式暴露，我们识别出暴露相关蛋白特征，这些特征沿共享的健康行为模式组织，并将生活方式变异与疾病相关生物学联系起来。整合疾病关联、中介分析、孟德尔随机化和共定位分析表明，只有少数暴露响应蛋白与因果中介一致，而许多似乎作为暴露负担、疾病易感性和早期疾病过程的生物学报告者发挥作用。与运动训练和胰高血糖素样肽-1受体激动剂研究的比较将观察性生活方式特征与干预诱导的蛋白质组变化联系起来，表明部分暴露组信号反映了可被干预改变的生物学。此外，基于蛋白质组的暴露评分捕捉了暴露相关生物学，追踪了随时间的行为变化，并预测了疾病风险。总体而言，HEAP通过将可改变生活方式暴露与疾病相关蛋白特征联系起来，为推进疾病预防和精准医学提供了资源。

papers.title: A Synbiotic Infant Formula Promotes Balanced Immune-Microbiome Interactions in Term Infants: A Randomized Controlled Trial
papers.translated_title: 一种合生元婴儿配方奶粉促进足月婴儿免疫-微生物组相互作用的平衡：一项随机对照试验
papers.author: Barcenilla, H.
papers.summary: Formula-fed infants have altered gut microbiota and immune development relative to breastfed infants. Human milk oligosaccharides (HMOs) and microbes able to ferment these, like Bifidobacterium infantis, promote healthy immune-microbiome interactions in breastfed infants. In this randomized trial, 240 healthy term infants in the Philippines received a synbiotic formula (SynF; seven HMOs, bovine milk oligosaccharides, and B. infantis LMG11588) or control formula (CtrlF) for 6 months. SynF supported growth non-inferior to CtrlF and near universal B. infantis colonization (vs <10% in CtrlF). Markers of intestinal inflammation were lower in children fed SynF while secretory IgA was higher. SynF fed infants showed lower markers of systemic inflammation in plasma, slower immune cell maturation, and fewer upper respiratory tract infections (URTI) during their first 6 months of life. These findings suggest that synbiotic formula can dampen inflammatory responses to colonizing microbes and mild infections in fully formula-fed, term infants. Trial registration: NCT06073652.
papers.translated_summary: 与母乳喂养的婴儿相比，配方奶喂养的婴儿肠道微生物群和免疫发育发生改变。人乳寡糖（HMOs）以及能够发酵这些寡糖的微生物（如婴儿双歧杆菌）可促进母乳喂养婴儿健康的免疫-微生物组相互作用。在这项随机试验中，菲律宾240名健康足月婴儿接受合生元配方（SynF：七种HMOs、牛乳寡糖和婴儿双歧杆菌LMG11588）或对照配方（CtrlF）喂养6个月。SynF支持的生长不劣于CtrlF，且婴儿双歧杆菌定植接近普遍（CtrlF中<10%）。喂养SynF的儿童肠道炎症标志物较低，而分泌型IgA较高。喂养SynF的婴儿血浆全身炎症标志物较低、免疫细胞成熟较慢，且在出生后前6个月内上呼吸道感染（URTI）较少。这些发现表明，合生元配方可减弱完全配方奶喂养的足月婴儿对定植微生物和轻度感染的炎症反应。试验注册号：NCT06073652。

papers.title: Risk-Based Cardiovascular-Kidney-Metabolic Staging Identifies a Population With Mortality Comparable to Established Cardiovascular Disease: Disability-Adjusted Life Years Across AHA Stages, 2005 to 2023
papers.translated_title: 基于风险的心血管-肾脏-代谢分期识别出死亡率与已确诊心血管疾病相当的人群：2005至2023年AHA各分期的伤残调整生命年
papers.author: Wang, X.
papers.summary: Background: Cardiovascular-kidney-metabolic (CKM) syndrome was defined in 2023 as a five-stage continuum, with stage 3 assigned on predicted rather than established cardiovascular disease. Whether that stage identifies a population whose mortality resembles clinical disease, and how health loss is distributed across stages, is unknown. Methods: We pooled nine National Health and Nutrition Examination Survey cycles (2005-2023) and assigned CKM stages 0-4 from measured risk factors, kidney function, urine albumin, self-reported cardiovascular disease, and 10-year PREVENT risk. Years lived with disability used Global Burden of Disease weights; years of life lost combined national death counts, linked mortality files, and period life tables. Results: In 2021-2023, stage prevalence was 13.8% (stage 0), 21.3% (stage 1), 49.1% (stage 2), 6.5% (stage 3), and 9.3% (stage 4). Crude mortality was 6,709 per 100,000 person-years in stage 3, comparable to 6,375 in stage 4. Adjusted hazard ratios rose from 1.39 in stage 2 to 3.22 in stage 4, with no excess in stage 1 (0.99). CKM accounted for 20.0 million DALYs annually, with 76% of attributable years of life lost in stages 3-4 (15.8% of adults). Lipid-lowering therapy was absent in 53.7% of stage 3 and 33.6% of stage 4 adults. Stage 0 prevalence fell 2.3% per year and stage 1 rose 3.1% per year between 2006 and 2016. Conclusions: Risk-based stage 3 carries short-term mortality indistinguishable from established cardiovascular disease, yet the population continues to shift into stage 1, where mortality is normal, and stage 3 receives less intensive lipid-lowering treatment than stage 4.
papers.translated_summary: 背景：心血管-肾脏-代谢（CKM）综合征于2023年被定义为一个五阶段连续体，其中第3阶段依据预测而非已确立的心血管疾病来划分。该阶段所识别的人群其死亡率是否与临床疾病相似，以及健康损失在各阶段之间如何分布，尚不清楚。方法：我们汇总了九个全国健康与营养调查周期（2005-2023），并根据测量的危险因素、肾功能、尿白蛋白、自报心血管疾病和10年PREVENT风险划分CKM 0-4阶段。带残障生存年数采用全球疾病负担权重；寿命损失年数综合了全国死亡计数、关联死亡档案和时期生命表。结果：2021-2023年，各阶段患病率为13.8%（0阶段）、21.3%（1阶段）、49.1%（2阶段）、6.5%（3阶段）和9.3%（4阶段）。3阶段的粗死亡率为每10万人年6,709例，与4阶段的6,375例相当。调整后风险比从2阶段的1.39升至4阶段的3.22，1阶段无超额风险（0.99）。CKM每年造成2,000万伤残调整生命年，其中76%的可归因寿命损失年数集中在3-4阶段（占成人的15.8%）。3阶段成人中53.7%、4阶段成人中33.6%未接受降脂治疗。2006年至2016年间，0阶段患病率每年下降2.3%，1阶段每年上升3.1%。结论：基于风险划分的3阶段其短期死亡率与已确立的心血管疾病难以区分，但人群仍持续向1阶段转移，而该阶段死亡率正常，且3阶段接受的降脂治疗强度低于4阶段。

papers.title: Real-World Twelve-Month Weight Loss Outcomes in a Comprehensive Obesity Care Program Utilizing Individualized Nutrition Therapy and Incretin-Based Obesity Medications
papers.translated_title: 综合肥胖护理项目中采用个体化营养治疗与基于肠促胰岛素的肥胖药物的真实世界十二个月减重结果
papers.author: Athinarayanan, S.
papers.summary: BackgroundIncretin-based obesity medications (IOMs) produce substantial weight loss, but the incremental benefit of structured nutritional therapy when integrated with pharmacotherapy remains unclear. ObjectivesTo compare 12-month weight-loss outcomes between individualized carbohydrate-reduced nutritional therapy combined with IOMs (VINT+IOM) and IOM-based care without structured nutritional therapy (IOM only). MethodsThis retrospective cohort study evaluated 4,269 adults enrolled in a comprehensive telemedicine obesity care program (VINT+IOM, n=1,658; IOM only, n=2,611). Both pathways included clinician-guided medication management and behavioral coaching. The primary analysis focused on GLP-1-naive participants receiving a single medication ingredient (semaglutide or tirzepatide). Adjusted weight changes were estimated using longitudinal linear mixed-effects models. Additional analyses evaluated weight-loss responders, prior GLP-1 exposure, and medication utilization. ResultsAmong GLP-1-naive semaglutide users, adjusted 12-month weight loss was greater with VINT+IOM than IOM only (30.7 vs. 24.1 lb; P=0.01), with corresponding observed weight loss of 13.3% versus 11.1%. Among tirzepatide users, adjusted weight loss was 45.9 versus 34.4 lb (P=0.003), with observed reductions of 19.7% versus 15.6%, respectively. Weight-loss responder rates consistently favored VINT+IOM. In the overall cohort (GLP-1 naive, prior users and all other treatment trajectories), adjusted weight loss was 29.4 versus 21.5 lb (P<0.001), with observed reductions of 12.7% versus 9.6%. Greater weight loss with VINT+IOM was also observed among participants with prior GLP-1 exposure. Weight loss continued between 6 and 12 months in both pathways. Medication coverage was high, with approximately 80% of participants achieving proportion of days covered [≥]80% in both pathways. ConclusionsIntegrating individualized carbohydrate-reduced nutritional therapy with IOM-based care was associated with greater 12-month weight loss than IOM-based care without structured nutritional therapy. These real-world findings support further evaluation of individualized nutritional approaches as an adjunct to incretin-based obesity pharmacotherapy.
papers.translated_summary: 背景：基于肠促胰素的肥胖药物（IOMs）可产生显著减重效果，但结构化营养治疗与药物治疗联合时的增量获益仍不明确。目的：比较个体化低碳水化合物营养治疗联合IOMs（VINT+IOM）与仅基于IOM的诊疗（IOM only）在12个月减重结局上的差异。方法：本回顾性队列研究评估了纳入综合远程医疗肥胖管理项目的4,269名成人（VINT+IOM，n=1,658；IOM only，n=2,611）。两种路径均包括临床医生指导的药物管理和行为辅导。主要分析聚焦于接受单一药物成分（司美格鲁肽或替尔泊肽）的GLP-1初治参与者。调整后体重变化采用纵向线性混合效应模型估计。额外分析评估了减重应答者、既往GLP-1暴露及药物使用情况。结果：在GLP-1初治的司美格鲁肽使用者中，VINT+IOM的调整后12个月减重优于IOM only（30.7 vs. 24.1 lb；P=0.01），相应观察到的减重为13.3% vs. 11.1%。在替尔泊肽使用者中，调整后减重为45.9 vs. 34.4 lb（P=0.003），观察到的减重分别为19.7% vs. 15.6%。减重应答率始终支持VINT+IOM。在总体队列中（GLP-1初治、既往使用者及所有其他治疗轨迹），调整后减重为29.4 vs. 21.5 lb（P<0.001），观察到的减重为12.7% vs. 9.6%。在既往有GLP-1暴露的参与者中，也观察到VINT+IOM减重更多。两种路径在6至12个月期间体重继续下降。药物覆盖率高，两种路径中约80%的参与者达到覆盖天数比例[≥]80%。结论：将个体化低碳水化合物营养治疗与基于IOM的诊疗相结合，与未联合结构化营养治疗的基于IOM的诊疗相比，12个月减重更多。这些真实世界研究结果支持进一步评估个体化营养方法作为基于肠促胰素的肥胖药物治疗的辅助手段。
